purpose: Task 1 PickLift real-only ACT engineering baseline

checkpoint_selection_rule.reason: Freeze the evaluation object before real-robot evaluation and avoid selecting on evaluation outcomes.

recipe.time_horizon_conversion: round(100 steps * 20 FPS / 30 FPS) = 67 steps; preserves the old approximately 3.33 second horizon at the new 20 FPS dataset rate

known_training_caveats: 529 joint-frame software-sent action labels across 22/24 episodes exceed the Follower calibrated position bounds, mainly shoulder_lift.
Raw data and labels are immutable; no label clipping is performed during training.
Deployment must clamp every policy action fail-closed to the exact current Follower calibrated bounds and log clamp events.
The batch includes repeated adjacent camera frames and uncalibrated camera intrinsics/extrinsics as recorded in qa_v1.
hardware_boundary: Training, checkpoint validation, and deployment preparation are offline only. Do not access serial ports, enable the Follower, send robot actions, or request 12 V before explicit user handoff.
